sample_size.notes: Right-angled ascending: horizontal lower boundary + rising upper boundary (highs ascending).

target_calculation.description: Compute formation height (highest high - lowest low at breakout point); project from breakout in breakout direction.

ultimate_high_method.definition: Highest price after upward breakout before 20% reversal

ultimate_low_method.definition: Lowest price after downward breakout before 20% reversal

failure_definition.description: Break-even failure: price fails to move 5% in breakout direction. See Table 6.3 for full curve.

failure_rate.notes: Bulkowski reports full failure-rate curve in Table 6.3 — values not extracted verbatim into this spec; reproducer should query PDF page 53-62.

post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_range_days: TBD (PDF Table 6.4 not yet extracted verbatim)
post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_note: Lookahead inherited from legacy default 252 bars (PDF Table 6.4 not yet extracted verbatim). Reproducer should run pdftotext -f 53 -l 62 for actual days to fill lookahead_range_days.

performance_statistics.notes: Most common variant is bull/UD (downward breakout in bull market) — 186 samples, often a bearish reversal.

notes: PDF source: Encyclopedia of Chart Patterns (2nd ed.), chapter 6, p53-62.
